name: system_monitor
description: System resource monitoring plugin. Checks CPU, memory, disk usage, and running processes.
author: JARVIS Team

commands.name: get_cpu_usage
commands.description: Get current CPU usage percentage and load averages.

commands.name: get_memory_usage
commands.description: Get current memory usage (used, free, total).

commands.name: get_disk_usage
commands.description: Get disk usage for a specified path.

path.description: Disk path to check, e.g. 'C:\' or '/'

commands.name: list_processes
commands.description: List top running processes by CPU or memory.
